Legal.usage_p: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you about projects, send marketing updates (if you have consented), and ensure the security of our platform.
Legal.rights_p: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. If you wish to exercise these rights or have questions about our data management, you can contact us at legal@xcalex.com.
Legal.updates_p: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this site.
Legal.acceptance_p: By accessing or using Xcalex services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.
Legal.utilization_p: Our services are designed for enterprise use. You agree not to use the platform for any illegal activity or in a way that compromises the integrity of our infrastructure.
Legal.property_p: All software, designs, and content provided by Xcalex are protected by intellectual property laws. Your use of the services does not grant you ownership of our technology.
Legal.liability_p: Xcalex will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use our technological solutions.
Legal.law_p: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where Xcalex is registered, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
Legal.what_this_means_p: We value your privacy. In accordance with privacy regulations, you have the right to opt-out of the 'sale' or 'sharing' of your personal information to third parties.
